newDefects.title: JSON config display exposes stored provider keys
newDefects.testName: adversarial config display ADV-CTX-001 JSON config output preserves model metadata without exposing stored key bytes
newDefects.expected: config show --json preserves useful provider/model metadata without printing stored apiKey bytes; the stored key stays unchanged.
newDefects.actual: The command exits0 and prints the literal fake stored key fixture-only-config-key-7f94a31c inside llm.custom.apiKey.
newDefects.cause: runConfigShowCommand writes JSON.stringify(cfg) without redacting apiKey fields.
newDefects.status: OPEN; ordinary failure measured on the frozen application ref; expected-failure test retained; no application repair included.

newDefects.title: CLI and MCP bulk import report successful records without persisting them
newDefects.testName: adversarial context and provider routing ADV-CTX-002 normal MCP bulk import persists the reported memories
newDefects.expected: Each non-dry-run import persists both structured memories and reports Imported:2.
newDefects.actual: At frozen commit f4b9135, CLI exits0 with Imported:2/Failed:0/Total:2 and MCP returns isError:false with the same counters; reopening the central DB after either isolated operation returns zero memories.
newDefects.cause: Both callers omit the optional DB argument to performImport, whose persistence block runs only when db is supplied. Both affected surfaces are now measured, not inferred.
newDefects.status: OPEN; ordinary failure measured on the frozen application ref; expected-failure test retained; no application repair included.
